channel.description: Daily snow reports for skiers: where the snow is, what is coming and where to ski, from the SnowScope snow map and measuring stations. Every number comes from that day's data.

item.title: Östersund snow depth: 19 to 33 cm around Storsjön, and it is staying (13 November 2026)
item.description: Measured snow around Östersund on 13 November 2026: 19 cm at Norderön, 24 cm at Marby, 33 cm at Rissna. Three to four times the usual depth for the date, with a cold, dry weekend ahead.

item.title: Himalaya snow cover, November 2026: what NASA MODIS saw from the Hindu Kush to Bhutan
item.description: Himalaya snow cover in November 2026 from NASA MODIS: snow on 610,409 km² of ground above 2,000 m between the Hindu Kush and Bhutan, half the clear ground white from about 4,800 m in Nepal and 3,600 m in the Karakoram. The NDSI explained, plus shadows, cloud and the low autumn sun.

item.title: Where is there snow in Norway right now? The hills above Oslo lead (13 November 2026)
item.description: Measured snow depth in Norway on 13 November 2026: 37 cm at Tryvannshøgda above Oslo, 44 cm at Lyngen in Troms, 10 to 18 cm in the inland valleys, bare ground in Bergen, Trondheim and inland Finnmark.

item.title: Alps snow cover from satellite, checked against 555 snow stations: white from about 2,000 m (13 November 2026)
item.description: Alps snow cover by satellite, 4 to 13 November 2026, checked on the ground. NASA MODIS mapped snow down to about 1,200 m, but 555 snow stations show the ground mostly white only from about 1,750 to 2,000 m. Above 1,500 m MODIS saw 41,400 km² of snow. How the NDSI works and where it went wrong this week.

item.title: Snow in Helsinki? Not this weekend: 0 cm at all five city stations (13 November 2026)
item.description: Helsinki snow depth on 13 November 2026: 0 cm at Kaisaniemi, Kumpula, Tapiola, Helsinki-Vantaa and Nuuksio. The usual first-snow date, and a weekend forecast that keeps the city grey.

item.title: Umeå snow depth: 20 cm in two days, far above normal (13 November 2026)
item.description: Umeå measured 20 cm of snow on 13 November 2026, up from bare ground on Wednesday. How the stations around the city compare, why this is early, and whether it survives Monday's rain.

item.title: Kiruna has no snow today: 0 cm where 46 winters out of 46 were white (13 November 2026)
item.description: Kiruna snow depth on 13 November 2026: 0 cm at the town station, at Jukkasjärvi and at Esrange. In our 46-winter snow history the town always had snow on this date. What the weekend brings.

item.title: Where is there snow in Sweden right now? A white belt in the middle (13 November 2026)
item.description: Measured snow depth across Sweden on 13 November 2026: 133 of 322 stations white, a belt from Dalarna to Västerbotten with up to 45 cm, a bare south and an almost bare far north around Kiruna.

item.title: Is there snow in Stockholm? Not yet: 0 cm measured (13 November 2026)
item.description: Stockholm snow depth on 13 November 2026: 0 cm at Observatoriekullen and at every station around the city. When the snow usually arrives, and why this weekend will not bring it.

item.title: Deer Valley, Utah ski conditions: is there snow yet? (13 November 2026)
item.description: Deer Valley ski conditions on 13 November 2026: no real snow on the ground yet, about 4 in near the top from the weekend storm, rain on the low East Village side below about 6,700 to 7,600 ft, and 11 in up top over the week.

item.title: Snow in Oslo today: 4 cm in town, 37 cm up at Tryvann (13 November 2026)
item.description: Measured snow depth in Oslo on 13 November 2026: 4 cm at Blindern, 31 cm at Bjørnholt and 37 cm at Tryvannshøgda. What a normal mid-November looks like, and what the weekend does to it.

item.description: Park City, Utah snowfall forecast for 13 November 2026: almost no snow on the ground right now, about 5 in near the summit from the weekend storm with a snow level of 7,400 to 7,700 ft, rain at the base, and about 12 in up top over the week.

item.description: Alpental snow forecast for 13 November 2026: about 1 in on the upper mountain, rain almost to the summit this weekend with a snow level near 5,400 to 5,600 ft, then 4 to 5 in of mixed rain and snow up top next week.

item.title: Bogus Basin snow: still bare, a wet weekend, colder next week (13 November 2026)
item.description: Bogus Basin snow check for Boise skiers on 13 November 2026: no snow on the ground yet, rain and mixed snow this weekend with a snow level near 6,300 to 6,800 ft, then colder air and about 8 in at the summit by next week.

item.description: Snow depth in St Anton am Arlberg on 13 November 2026: about 1 cm at the top (2642 m), 5 cm at mid-mountain, bare in the village. This week 42 cm at the top and 33 cm mid-mountain, rain below about 1480 m. How deep is deep enough for the steep runs.

item.description: Obergurgl snow report for 13 November 2026: about 20 cm at the top (3024 m), 5 cm at mid-mountain, bare at the lowest lifts (1784 m). Snow forecast for the week: 34 cm up high, 21 cm low down, snow line near 1700 m. Plus the usual early season.

item.title: Snowfall in Val Thorens: 27 cm this week at the top, 86 cm more on the way (13 November 2026)
item.description: Snowfall in Val Thorens, 13 November 2026: 27 cm fell at the top (3175 m) and 17 cm at 2498 m over seven days; snow depth is 50 cm and 8 cm. Next seven days: 86 cm at the top, 73 cm at 2498 m, snow line well below the village. Usual snowfall season from 46 winters.

item.title: Snow depth in Chamonix: a bare valley, 12 cm at Brévent, 5 to 24 cm up on the Grands Montets (13 November 2026)
item.description: Snow depth in Chamonix on 13 November 2026, height by height: nothing on the valley floor, 1 cm at 2001 m, 12 cm at the top of Brévent-Flégère (2486 m), 5 to 24 cm at the top of the Grands Montets (2768 m). About a metre forecast up high this week, rain in the valley. How deep Chamonix usually gets, from 46 winters.

item.description: Snow depth in Ischgl on 13 November 2026: about 5 cm at the top (2868 m), 4 cm at mid-mountain, none in the valley at 1352 m. Up to 42 cm on the ridge this week, rain in the Paznaun below about 1570 m. Plus valley and ridge over 46 past winters.
